usage: Independent cosmetic player avatars; unrelated to game roles.

avatars.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original square player avatar for an Avalon social deduction web game, in a new independent cosmetic avatar pool.
Create one individual character portrait, not a grid or contact sheet. This must be a completely new face, not an existing Avalon role character.
Style: cohesive polished hand-painted fantasy storybook gouache illustration, semi-realistic appealing adult face, simplified bold forms, clean facial silhouette, soft textured brushwork. Subtle medieval everyday clothing. Clear eyes and facial features readable when reduced to a 40px circular avatar.
Composition: square 1:1 image, centered head and upper shoulders filling about 80 percent of the frame, looking toward the viewer, complete hair silhouette with breathing room, all important features inside a centered circular crop. Flat softly textured color background, strong separation between face and background, gentle diffuse front lighting.
Constraints: one adult only; no text, no letters, no numbers, no borders, no watermarks, no emblems, no crowns, no armor, no weapons, no wizard hats, no mystical effects, no explicit faction or role signals. Not a photo and not a 3D render.
Subject: A young adult woman with short copper-red wavy hair, freckles, a relaxed friendly smile, and a simple moss-green wool cloak. Muted sage background.
